mapper.select: select mtl.Met_Name as metName, c1.C_Name as brandSupplierName, c2.C_Name as brandProducerName, apl.Bla_Code as blaCode, apl.Bla_Title as blaTitle, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_BrandLibrary mn left join Me_Type_Library mtl on mtl.Met_Id = mn.Met_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Brand_Supplier left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Brand_Producer left join Me_BrandLibrary_Apply apl on apl.Bla_Id = mn.Bla_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.Met_Id = #{metId} and mn.State = 7 order by mn.Create_Time DESC

select mtl.Met_Name as metName, c1.C_Name as brandSupplierName, c2.C_Name as brandProducerName, apl.Bla_Code as blaCode, apl.Bla_Title as blaTitle, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_BrandLibrary mn left join Me_Type_Library mtl on mtl.Met_Id = mn.Met_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Brand_Supplier left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Brand_Producer left join Me_BrandLibrary_Apply apl on apl.Bla_Id = mn.Bla_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}
